CommunityApplications.Profile: Official application template for botdarr, a chat bot for searching, adding, and monitoring Radarr, Sonarr, and Lidarr content from Discord, Telegram, Slack, Matrix, or Mattermost. The template, the project, and the Docker image (shayaantx/botdarr on Docker Hub) are all maintained at https://github.com/shayaantx/botdarr.
